item.title: Easter Punch
item.description: Easter Punch recipe! Perfect for brunch or kids’ parties, this non-alcoholic drink is made with cranberry-strawberry juice, and pineapple.

item.title: Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
item.description: These soft and chewy Double Chocolate Chip Cookies are rich, fudgy, and loaded with chocolate! An easy no-chill recipe for chocolate lovers.

item.title: Easter Dirt Cake Casserole
item.description: This easy Easter Dirt Cake Casserole is a no-bake dessert made with cream cheese, Cool Whip, pudding, and OREOs. An old fashioned Easter recipe that’s fun, festive, and perfect for feeding a crowd.

item.title: Easter Poke Cake
item.description: This easy Easter Poke Cake recipe is made with cake mix, pudding, Cool Whip, and festive pastel colors. A fun, old fashioned Easter dessert topped with Peeps and bunny decorations.

item.title: Strawberry Jello Poke Cake
item.description: This Strawberry Jello Poke Cake recipe is easy, moist, and full of classic strawberry flavor. Made with cake mix, Jello, and Cool Whip, it’s a crowd favorite.

item.title: Easter Salad
item.description: This Easter Salad recipe is fresh, colorful, and perfect for spring brunch or Easter dinner. Made with strawberries, spinach, feta, and an easy homemade vinaigrette.

item.title: Italian Easter Cookies
item.description: Traditional Italian Easter Cookies (anginetti) are soft, buttery, and easy to make with almond or anise—an old fashioned Easter classic.

item.title: Orange Rolls
item.description: Orange Rolls are soft, fluffy, and bursting with fresh citrus flavor. Made with real orange zest and topped with a creamy orange cream cheese frosting, this easy orange rolls recipe is perfect for brunch, holidays, or weekend baking.

item.title: Easy Strawberry Filling for Cake
item.description: Easy strawberry filling recipe made from scratch with fresh strawberries. Thick, glossy, and perfect for cake layers, cupcakes, and desserts.

item.title: OREO Rolls
item.description: These Oreo Rolls are soft, fluffy cookies-and-cream sweet rolls filled with crushed OREOs and topped with rich Oreo cream cheese frosting. A bakery-style treat made at home.
